evidence.quote: Search venue ID 60879; locality=San Francisco; region=CA; is_tock_inventory=false.
Venue ID 60879; address: 4072 18th St, San Francisco, CA, 94114; country=US; is_active=1.
Located on the second floor of a Victorian building from 1907.

Owned and operated by Francesco d'Ippolito, and staffed by an experienced, multi-cultured family of hosts whom are all passionate about the experience and concept, Poesia is the latest addition of authentic Italian cuisine to call San Francisco its home. Nestled in the middle of the vibrant and colorful neighborhood of the Castro, Poesia features the finest in hand-made, traditional ingredients and pastas, combined with meticulous preparation and presentation that is second to none. It is with every intention to give our patrons a warm, intimate experience with superior attention not just to our menu, but to the relationship we have with every guest. Our hearty and delightful dishes will embody the passion and zest of Italian cuisine coming from the owner's home of Calabria, teasing your palette with rustic herbs and fruitful aromas. Poesia. Italian for poetry, yet the embodiment of an experience that is so much more.

Reservations are reserved for guests joining us for dinner service in our dining room, bar, or outdoor heated Patio
If you are planning to stop by for drinks and light bites only, we kindly ask that you do not book a reservation. Walk-ins are always welcome, and we’ll do our best to accommodate you at the bar or at a table based on availability. You are also welcome to call us ahead of time to check availability.
Please note that we do not offer a children’s menu.
Street parking is usually easy to find.

Discover Memento SF – Where Culinary Passion Meets Artistic Flair

Nestled in the heart of Noe Valley, Memento SF offers an unforgettable dining experience that transcends the ordinary. More than just a restaurant, it's a celebration of creativity, flavor, and community.

Reservations are available 30 days in advance. Our bar and a few small tables are held nightly for walk-in diners and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. We now require a credit card to hold reservations for parties of 3+. Cancellations within 24 hours and no-shows will be charged $20 per person. We’re a cozy lil  spot, and to accommodate all our guests, we kindly ask that dining be limited to 90 minutes. Thank you for helping us keep the evening flowing!

If your party arrives or is incomplete more than 10 minutes past the reservation time, we will need to honor our party on our waitlist. We will do our best to accommodate you but may need to expedite your dining experience to honor the next reservation.

Big Groups
Due to our  limited seating and our environment best for smaller groups, we're not able to accommodate larger groups (over 6 people) at this time. If you're looking to book a party event (lunch/ dinner), please reach out to jilli.sf25@gmail.com

How to get to Jilli
Parking is limited (you know how it gets in the mission!) We're 2 mins walk from the Mission 16th Bart Station. 

Last calls
Last calls for both food and drinks are at 9pm.

How to contact us
We will not be able to get to the phone due to the small size of the team. We are best reached by emailing us at jilli.sf25@gmail.com or through resy text. 

Patio
As for patio reservations-  we are not covered and have limited heaters- in case of rain, we will need to cancel the reservations- thank you for your patience, we are working towards building a covered patio space soon!

Highchairs
Jilli's tight space and loud music is not the best place for babies and we do not have any high-chairs to accommodate.

We are all about that cloudy fizzy rice wine, pouring small batch brews next to a changing lineup of natural wines, craft beer, and premium soju. Our menu is a playful mix of Korean inspired plates that shift with the seasons and whatever we are vibing with. Think creamy tuna dip with saltines, kimchi vodka rigatoni, crispy shrimp toast, and boneless  Korean fried chicken with spicy yang "yum" sauce.

Our menu is Omakase (tasting menu), offering three Chef’s Choice (Oki-"Large", Chisai-"Small", Yasai- "Vegetables")  dining options per guest. We do not offer shared Omakase or a la carte options.  

Chīsai- it’s in the name. We are “small” and pride ourselves on providing a fun, approachable omakase experience for each of our guests while compensating all of our staff equitably.  With that in mind, we ask that guests honor reservations by arriving on time, as we consider a reservation a mutual commitment; from us to give our guests ample time to enjoy their experience, and from our guests to respect the work of the chefs and the experience of the subsequent guests in their seats. We thank you in advance for your cooperation.

PLEASE READ regarding Cancellations, No-Shows, and Late arrivals. 
-Cancellations within 8 hours of a reservation will incur a $35 per guest charge, and No Shows will always incur a $35 per guest charge.  We will hold your reservation for 30 minutes if running late, after which your party may incur a $35 per guest charge and be unable to seat.  If you are running late, please communicate with our staff to let us know your ETA.  We do not have a working telephone number, please use the text messages you receive regarding your reservation via Resy to communicate with us or send an email to info@chisaisushiclub.com if you have any questions or issues.  
-Please give yourselves plenty of time to find parking; there is no dedicated parking, so we recommend street parking in the neighborhood hills nearby. We do not recommend parking in the lots of the nearby big name retailers.
-all reservations are allotted for 1 hour and 45 minutes for the optimal experience. 

Other Notes:
-We are a very small and intimate space; for any reservations of parties larger than 5, please email info@chisaisushiclub.com to coordinate. 
-Gratuity is not included, and we distribute tips equitably with all staff. 
-We love our furry friends, but they are not allowed to dine indoors with us per  California Health & Safety Code 114259.5 with the exception of service animals. Misrepresenting service animals is a misdemeanor (California Penal Code 365.7 [a]). Please make plans to leave your animal at home or at a safe place outside our restaurant.

Chīsai Sushi Club provides an approachable, sustainable, Omakase (Tasting menu) in a friendly and intimate neighborhood setting.  Our guests can expect a uniquely crafted dining experience whether seated at the sushi bar or at a table. Our Omakase menu features classic San Francisco dishes prepared with the Bay Area's bounty of seasonal ingredients and refined with Japanese techniques and flavors.

In booking a reservation with mijoté, you agree to our reservation policy. We require 48 hours of advance notice for any cancellation or adjustment to your reservation. Cancellations within 48 hours of your reservation will incur an $86-per-person fee, charged to the credit card taken at the time of your booking. Arriving with fewer than your full party will also incur an $86 charge for each absent diner.

***

DIETARY RESTRICTIONS

Please let us know of any dietary and allergy restrictions **for your entire party**. We will do our best to accommodate, but some requests we are unable to meet. If you have any questions, please reach out to us at hello@mijotesf.com.

We cannot accommodate requests for NO DAIRY **butter, milk, cream** and cannot make any adjustments regarding these ingredients.

We are able to accommodate vegetarian and pescatarian requests. We cannot accommodate vegan requests.

We cannot meet same-day requests. Thank you for understanding.

We offer a four-course fixed dinner menu that changes at least every week according to the seasons, the weather, the team's emotions, and the offerings of our local producers. 

Dinner reservations are available 5-9 pm Thursday through Monday. Reservations are recommended. We accept walk-ins as availability allows.

Bon appétit!

IMPORTANT RESERVATION INFORMATION:

- GENERAL RESERVATIONS: Reservations for 1-8 guests are available 28 days in advance starting at 10:00 a.m.

- LIMITED SEATINGS: All tables are reserved for a scheduled amount of time: 1.75 hours for parties of 2 guests, 2 hours for parties of 3-5 guests and up to 2.5 hours for parties of 6-8 guests. Please arrive on time with your completed party. If you're running late by more than 10 minutes, please notify us and be aware that your dining time may be shortened in order to accommodate the next scheduled reservation.

- COURTYARD RESERVATIONS: Courtyard seating is open-air and weather permitting. We recommend dressing in layers as San Francisco weather varies and heating coverage is limited.

- STRICT CANCELLATION POLICY:  We require 24 hours notice for free cancellations. Cancellations and re-bookings within 24 hours are subject to a cancellation/no-show fee of $50/person. 

- LARGE PARTIES: Groups of 6-8 adults are required to order our nightly set menu @ $90/person. Larger parties of 9+ adults are required to make a reservation through our events page and participate in a banquet menu (izakayarintaro.com/events). Parties must be complete in order to be seated.

- ALLERGIES: If there are any strict allergies or dietary restrictions in your party, please notify us in case we need to make special accommodations.

- SERVICE FEE: Parties of 6+ are subject to a 20% service charge in lieu of gratuity.

If you have any questions or need to reach a member of our team, please email info@izakayarintaro.com or call (415) 589-7022. If your call is not answered, please be sure to leave a voice message.

Here's proof: konbu-cured Marin coast halibut sashimi with Half Moon Bay wasabi and handmade udon made daily.

If reservations are full, feel free to walk in and enjoy the Penny Roma dinner menu at the Pasta Shop, directly in front of Penny Roma!  For a stellar cocktail, Trick Dog bar is just next door!

Penny Roma is a culinary creation by Flour + Water Hospitality Group, led by co-chefs and partners Ryan Pollnow and Thomas McNaughton.

We bring the simplicity of straightforward and traditional Italian cooking to San Francisco’s Mission District with a focus on tried and true pasta dishes from around Italy in a warm, lively atmosphere. Along with wood fired meats, vegetable driven antipasti and contorni, we will also be featuring a rotating mix of fresh raw fish. Penny Roma is excited to feature seasonal ingredients sourced from our favorite local farms & purveyors, as well as an eccentric yet unpretentious wine list balancing classic and natural wines from Italy, California and unique growing regions from around the world. 

We offer our Pasta Shop Dinner Party Table for all parties of 7-10. Booking this table requires the full party's participation in our Dinner Party Menu at $95 per person. This is not a Private Dining Room but rather a large table located within our Pasta Shop. For parties larger than 10 or for general Private Dining inquiries, please contact events@fwhospitality.com and our events team will get back to you within 24 hours with availability.

Penny Roma does not offer outdoor seating. Our adjacent restaurant, the Flour + Water Pasta Shop, is now a part of Penny Roma dinner service from 5:30-10PM offering both large party and walk-in seating.

Some Helpful Details about your Reservation at Bar Gemini:

-If you are planning on just having drinks, please walk in for our Bar. Our tables are for customers who will be joining us for food and drinks. 

-If a reservation is unavailable, we save plenty of room for walk-ins (more than half of our space). If you've booked a table and prefer to sit at the bar, we'll do our best to accommodate upon arrival. 

-We have a 1 drink minimum per guest

-All cancellations & revisions must be made 24 hours prior to your reservation via the Resy app. Our Reservation Cancellation Fee is $40.00 per guest. If you no show we will always charge. We understand things happen that are out of your control and we will do our best to assist within reason. You can very easily text us directly or via the chat function is Resy for any changes.

-Bar Gemini is text only and we can be reached at 415-940-9808

-We have a 15 minute grace period for all reservations. After that 15 minutes, we will release the table.

-Due to the size of the bar we ask that parties of two spend no more than 1 hour & 30 minutes at their table and for parties of 3 or more no more that two hours.

-If you're booking an outside table we do have overheard heaters that work really well. Please bring an extra layer just in case. You are welcome to bring well behaved dogs

-We only seat complete parties. If anyone in your party is late we may need to give your table an out by time.

-If you're booking this reservation we assume you have read all of the above and that you will show up for your reservation on time. We only have 36 seats in the entirety of our space so a no show impacts our evening greatly. If you're unsure you will make a reservation we suggest walking in instead. Thank You!

Bar Gemini is a neighborhood Natural Wine Bar in the Mission District of San Francisco. We are the partner restaurant of our Wine & Spirits shop Gemini Bottle & Market located a few blocks away on 22nd Street. We serve a diverse menu made by our friends at Ernest Restaurant.

A small, three location craft sushi family company… 

We are a small, three location craft sushi family company rooted in the Japanese tradition of splendidly fresh ingredients sourced from all over the world and delivered to us every day. In our sushi chef’s able hands these traditions are magically transformed into something special – we dance with tradition!!

*Everyone can sometimes be late to a scheduled reservation and we understand this. We enforce a “whole party must be present before seating” policy for reservations and it’s rooted in caring about everyone's time managament. Thank you for understanding.

A small, three location craft sushi family company in San Francisco  serving Russian Hill, Hayes Valley and TenderNob since 2012. 

We are rooted in the Japanese tradition of splendidly fresh ingredients sourced from all over the world and delivered to us every day. In our sushi chef’s able hands these traditions are magically transformed into something special – we dance with tradition!!
 
Elephant Sushi is a family of hospitality professionals passionate about the craft of sushi, cocktails and service.
After years of creating and experimentation, what you see is a menu of all time stars, crafted by our loving hands and a never ending desire to exceed your expectations. Our strong relationship with purveyors ensures immaculately sourced fish delivered every day. Food service is our pride.

evidence.quote: Search venue ID 667; locality=San Francisco; region=CA; is_tock_inventory=false.
Venue ID 667; address: 2501 Mariposa Street, San Francisco, CA, 94110; country=US; is_active=1.

We offer two seating options, INDOORS & OUTDOORS.  If you have booked outdoors, please dress appropriately. While we have heaters at every table in our covered parklet and offer blankets upon request, San Francisco weather is a fickle mistress. Thank you for letting us host you at The Morris!

Many years in the making, The Morris is the restaurant its founder Paul Einbund has always revered — the modest, unpretentious bistro where you can eat and drink at world-class level. The emphasis here is ever on flavor, from chef Gavin Schmidt’s straightforward, pure cuisine to the unique collection of wines and spirits amassed by Einbund, a well-known sommelier, over decades of travels. Yet at its heart, The Morris, named after Einbund’s late father, aspires to be a that warm neighborhood restaurant which will find and nourish its own community.

Gialina is named after chef-owner Sharon Ardiana's grandmother, Nonni Lina. It is a tribute to her Italian family, who came from a town in Italy's culinary heartland of Emilia-Romagna. As seen in the family photos that line the restaurant's walls, Nonni liked to surround herself with food and family. The menu is built around what is fresh and seasonal (with the kitchen sourcing as much as they can from local farms Star Route, Feed Sonoma & Martin B), consisting of fresh antipasti and salads, delicious thin-crust pizzas and a roast of the day.

Born in 1995, in an abandoned warehouse in SOMA, Basil was a project started by a group of young Thai artists, architects, DJ’s, & musicians who all had a love affair with Thailand. Their singular shared vision was to create a restaurant that captured the energy, vibrancy and allure of Bangkok, through food, space and music, one that did not conform to the standards. We continue on with the effort through our commitment to sourcing the best ingredients for our food and to draw from traditional, urban and progressive techniques to bring you the spirit of Bangkok in a bite.

Where good food & strong drinks will never go out of style! And where space & sound are as vibrant as the flavors of each dish.

Venue ID 93609; address: 1737 Post St, San Francisco, CA, 94115; country=US; is_active=1.

Welcome to Benihana, a dining experience unlike any other! Our guests are seated at communal tables in groups, where your personal chef will perform the ancient art of Teppanyaki. Watch as we slice and dice, preparing a meal that will dazzle your eyes as well taste buds, whether you choose mouth-watering steak, tender chicken or succulent seafood. You can also enjoy sushi prepared by a talented sushi chef and indulge in a specialty cocktail. To make your experience even more rewarding, don’t miss out on our new loyalty program, Friends With Benefits! Instantly unlock member status and get a free appetizer reward to enjoy during your next dining visit. Register today by visiting our website or ask your server for more details.

STRICT CANCELLATIONS: We require 24 hours notice for cancellations to avoid a $20 per person fee (parties of 1-5). Same day bookings + cancellations are considered no shows.

DIETARY RESTRICTIONS: Nari cannot accommodate severe celiac, peanut, or shellfish allergies, sugar or allium restrictions, or guests who are simultaneously vegetarian and gluten free. Please email info@narisf.com to discuss ALL restrictions as we may not be able to accommodate without advanced notice. 

LOUNGE + MEZZANINE DINING: Nari serves the full a la carte menu in the mezzanine bar, while the Chef's Pick is only available in the main dining room and for lounge reservations.

NARI ENTRANCE: The entrance to Nari is located through the lobby of Hotel Kabuki, which is also accessible by the Japantown Center Garage.

PARKING: Please allow ample time to find parking on the street or in the Japantown Center Garage as we are only able to hold the table for 15 minutes. We may not be able to accommodate if you arrive later than 15 minutes.

We encourage you to visit the FAQ page on narisf.com for more information on our policies.

Nari is a modern Thai restaurant, merging traditional techniques with the seasonal bounty of California. Served family style, our heritage driven cuisine is enhanced with exceptional service, amazing cocktails and an extensive wine list.

Venue ID 93303; address: 1420 Irving St, San Francisco, CA, 94122; country=US; is_active=1.

Welcome to IPOT, the Inner Sunset’s premier destination for interactive dining! We invite you to become the chef at your own table with our all-you-can-eat hotpot and BBQ experience. Our true specialty is our selection of 18 signature house-made broths, each simmered for hours to create a rich and complex base for your culinary creations. Enjoy the best of both worlds as you simmer ingredients in flavorful broths or grill premium marinated meats to perfection, choosing from an extensive selection of high-quality meats, fresh seafood, and a vibrant array of vegetables. This is Brenda's original location on Polk Street in San Francisco. 
New Hours: Monday-Wednesday 8am-3pm; Thursday-Sunday 8am-8pm
We hold lots of tables for walk ins, so if you don't see a table available online, please do stop by in person--We'd love to see you! Just drop in and put your name on our chalkboard.

- IMPORTANT RESERVATION INFORMATION:

At Pinsa Rossa, we understand that plans change and that sometimes restaurant reservations must be cancelled. 

Due to the small size of our restaurant, we hold the table for a grace period of 15 minutes before offering the reservation to our waitlist and be aware that your dining time may be shortened in order to accommodate the next scheduled reservation. If the table is promised to other reservations, we reserve the right to deliver your check to wrap up your visit.

We cannot guarantee a seat indoors if you book an outdoor table and the weather takes a turn for the worse.

- LIMITED SEATINGS: 
All tables are reserved for a scheduled amount of time: 1.5 hours for parties of 2-4 guests, 2 hours for parties of 5-6 guests or more.

**NOTE: WE ARE UNABLE TO SEAT SEPARATE PARTIES TOGETHER, OR SIDE BY SIDE, OR TO COMBINE TABLES, UNLESS THE MINIMUM SPEND FOR A LARGER PARTY IS MET.  NO EXCEPTIONS. 

We thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
To cancel or reschedule please call 415-340-7718 or email us at ken@pinsarossa.com.

Pinsa Rossa is a new Roman-style pinseria located in the heart of Pacific Heights in San Francisco. We feature the pinsa romana, a unique Roman- style pizza. All pinsas are pressed by hand and topped with imported natural and traditional ingredients.

Established in 1971, Marrakech Moroccan Restaurant is proud to be America's first Moroccan restaurant. Located in the heart of San Francisco, Marrakech offers an immersive dining experience featuring authentic Moroccan cuisine, handcrafted cocktails, live belly dancing, and warm Moroccan hospitality.

Guests relax on traditional Moroccan seating while enjoying signature dishes such as Bastilla, slow-braised lamb, couscous, tagines, fresh salads, and house-made desserts. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, planning a memorable date night, or gathering with friends and family, Marrakech delivers an unforgettable evening of food, culture, music, and entertainment.

Step through our doors and experience the sights, flavors, and traditions of Morocco—without leaving San Francisco.

419 O'Farrell Street, San Francisco, CA

Established 1971

Live Belly Dancing • Full Bar • Authentic Moroccan Cuisine

Portuguese and Japanese port city traditions. Rooted in the century-old Spanish Colonial
Revival architecture of Hotel Spero, the space blends rustic-modern warmth with the
multicultural spirit of the city. The menu celebrates recognizable, crave-able tavern fare
elevated through coastal influences, global pantry staples, and California seasonality.
Designed to feel warm, eclectic, and unpretentious, Bar Esper is a neighborhood hideaway
and a destination for curious travelers — a place to gather, graze, sip, and stay awhile.

In Gujarati families, food is never just food. It’s stories, opinions, second helpings, and someone insisting you haven’t eaten enough. This menu is a collection of memories, cravings, and flavors that followed Chef Heena Patel from Gujarat to San Francisco—street-food adventures, family recipes passed down through generations of women, and a few dishes born simply from asking, “What happens if I try this?” Besharam means “shameless,” and it felt like the perfect name for a restaurant built on cooking without apology. As you turn these pages, you’ll travel through three chapters inspired by Gujarat’s spirit: Community, Abundance, and Resilience—a celebration of the people, places, and traditions that shaped this journey. Take your time, order generously, and pass the chutneys.

Mirroring the creative spirit of the Minnesota Street Project, Besharam features custom artwork from HateCopy pop artist Maria Qamar, who depicts the life and times of first generation Desi diaspora in her pieces.

• Tables have time limits starting from your reservation time. Please be on time and respectful of those that have reservations at the table after you. Tables times are 1.5 hours for parties of 1-4 people, and 2 hours for parties of 5+ people. 

• We allow a 15-minute grace period from the time of your reservation for all parties to arrive: seating cannot be guaranteed after this window.

• Parking is available Monday - Friday at the UCSF 590 Illinois parking garage. The garage is located on Mariposa St between 3rd St and Illinois St. The entrance for the garage is located at 590 Illinois. Please note the garage closes at 10 pm.

• Once seated, patrons will be asked to use their smart devices to access our online menu.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. Bring a jacket if you have an outside table reservation!

Moshi Moshi is a San Francisco Legacy Japanese restaurant run by longtime SF restauranteur, Mitsuru Akashi. Mitsuru dreamed of offering Nihon-centric cuisine with finely crafted cocktails and an emphasis on Japanese whisky. The owner, Mitsuru, often expounds about the wafu of Moshi Moshi and what it means to offer his heart to the patrons. Wafu is not just Japanese style but the way that Moshi reflects the amalgamation of the employees’ personalities and the essence of simple Japanese style back at the patrons. He is not concerned with authentic Japanese cuisine but focused on how the employees and their heritage and passions influence the Japanese style and cuisine at Moshi Moshi. Mitsuru says this way of thinking is Moshi-wafu.

We strongly recommend reservations for tables in our main dining room.   We have 12 seats at the bar where full lunch and dinner menus are served on a first-come-first-serve basis.  Happy Hour menu is available daily from 4:00pm to 6:00pm.

For parties of 7 or more or private event inquiries, please email us at events@ungraftedsf.com.  Follow us on IG @ungraftesf and be the first to claim seats at our special dining events, wine classes, and tastings. 

Both metered and hourly parking spaces are available around the neighborhood and Muni T Line offers several stops along the 3rd Street corridor.  We recommend taking public transportation or ride-sharing if you plan to enjoy our selection of beverages.

See you at Ungrafted soon!

Ungrafted is a chef-driven, fine casual, neighborhood restaurant. Our Chef draws inspiration from distinct taste memories and playfully balances flavors to share his own interpretations of these experiences with our guests.  

The wine program, complementing the Chef's hunt for flavors, showcases balanced wines with strong personalities. Rebecca Fineman, MS, meticulously assembled the collection to satisfy all of our guests, from the newly-curious to the aficionados.   

Our team of sommeliers (yes, all of our serving staff are sommeliers) is one of the best in class when it comes to creating fond memories for our guests.  
We love great food, yummy wines, and lots of laughters.  Come in and share our passion!

Reservations encouraged for main dining room. Walk-ins are welcome based on availability an lounge or bar seating is first come, first serve. Valet parking is available at The Huntington Hotel entrance. Enter The Big Four from the exterior entrance on the SE corner of California Street and Taylor street within The Huntington Hotel building. Since 1976, The Big Four has stood as a culinary landmark in Nob Hill, sharing good company and iconic classics amidst a historic and romantic ambiance. Located within The Huntington Hotel, The Big Four returns in its 50th year with New American cuisine, a classic bar, live piano music nightly and rich in San Francisco history. Leading the kitchen, Award-Winning Executive Chef David Intonato brings elegant technique and approachable style to the menu, featuring hearty, celebratory dishes inspired by supper club tradition with a nod to modern sensibility. For breakfast, lunch and dinner, guests can expect American classics with a California lens, showcasing fresh, regional produce, coastal seafood and premium cuts.

Table Time Limit: 

To ensure a great dining experience for all guests, we kindly ask that table time be limited to 2 hours.

Dietary Restrictions & Allergies

To preserve the integrity of our dishes, we kindly ask guests to review the following dietary considerations before making a reservation:

* Vegetarian & Vegan: We offer a limited selection of vegetarian and vegan dishes. Please note that we may not be able to accommodate all dietary preferences.
* Substitutions: Our dishes are thoughtfully composed as intended by our chefs, and we are unable to accommodate ingredient substitutions or modifications.
* Core Ingredients: Our cuisine may include core ingredients such as garlic, onion, chili, coconut, fish sauce, shrimp paste, and other traditional Thai ingredients. Guests with allergies or intolerances to these ingredients should inform us before booking, as we may not be able to accommodate certain restrictions.
* Severe Shellfish Allergies: Due to the frequent use of shellfish and shared preparation areas in our kitchen, we are unable to safely accommodate guests with severe shellfish allergies.

Please inform us of any dietary restrictions or allergies when making your reservation. While we will do our best to accommodate where possible, we cannot guarantee that every dietary restriction can be accommodated.

SAAM is a modern Thai restaurant celebrating the depth and diversity of Thai cuisine through seasonal ingredients, thoughtful craftsmanship, and warm hospitality. Rooted in tradition and inspired by the harmony of Thailand’s signature flavors, SAAM offers a fresh perspective on Thai dining in San Francisco.

Located in the heart of San Francisco’s Richmond District, Harajuku Sushi is a local Japanese restaurant known for its fresh seafood, welcoming atmosphere, and satisfying dining experience. We proudly offer both traditional à la carte dining and our popular All-You-Can-Eat (AYCE) menu, giving guests the freedom to enjoy Japanese cuisine their way.

Our menu features a wide variety of sushi, sashimi, specialty rolls, nigiri, hand rolls, appetizers, rice bowls, and hot kitchen favorites made fresh to order. From classic favorites to creative signature rolls, we focus on quality ingredients, generous portions, and flavors that keep our guests coming back.

Harajuku Sushi is especially loved for its AYCE experience, where friends, families, students, and sushi lovers can enjoy an exciting variety of dishes in a fun and relaxed setting. Whether you’re stopping by for a casual dinner, celebrating with a group, enjoying a late-night meal, or introducing someone to sushi for the first time, our team strives to make every visit memorable.

In addition to dine-in service, we also offer takeout and online ordering for guests who want to enjoy Harajuku Sushi at home.

At Harajuku Sushi, we believe great food brings people together — and we look forward to welcoming you soon.

1814 Clement St, San Francisco, CA 94121
(415) 387-2441

The West Coast's first Nikkei Handroll Bar is on Union Street! Brought to you by the KAIYŌ brand, the rich Peruvian Nikkei flavors meet the streets of Osaka to shine in this new concept by John Park.

Offering daily dinner service with seasonal Handroll selections, including table side options making the freshest handrolls the Bay has to offer. While KAIYŌ Handroll Bar focuses on handrolls anyone looking for a full dinner can expect KAIYŌ classics like Lomo Saltado. 

Each meal pairs perfectly with the curated bar program by Danny Louie. A full service cocktail bar featuring Japanese Whiskeys, premium Peruvian Piscos, and unique craft cocktails that will transport you to Nikkei lands. The drink menu includes a full matcha menu with non-alcoholic options including a matcha soft serve. For those looking for a twist - matcha based cocktails that are quintessentially KAIYŌ are available. 

Weekends will include vibey DJs with rotating vinyl and digital sounds to keep the night going for our late night crowd. Grab a handroll, pick your cocktails, and pull up a seat for the best new spot in San Francisco.

We love spontaneity, so we'll always keep a slug of seats for first come, first served.

No seed, or processed oils.  Animals are pasture raised, vegetables are grown in rich dark soil.  Our unique and thoughtfully managed wines are so very good.  Let's eat!  

Also, open for daytime counter service Friday to Sunday, from 9:00 to 2:30 with St. Frank coffee to go with your blueberry masa waffle...  or market salad.  No reservation needed (or taken)!

A neighborhood restaurant using a wood burning oven to turn seasonal ingredients into beautifully simple dishes.  We start with just the good stuff, add some meticulously curated wines and a whole lotta village kindness.
Great meals start with great farmers, roasters, brewers and winemakers who understand Mother Earth and her seasons like few do.  Eat what you love.  Do it with thought, do it with the season, and whenever you can, do it with others.

Milos Meze sets itself apart in San Francisco's Marina District by offering an authentic Greek dining experience that transports guests straight to the heart of the Mediterranean. What makes us unique is our dedication to traditional Greek meze—small plates meant for sharing—that highlight the rich and diverse flavors of Greek cuisine. Signature dishes like our Keftedes, grilled lamb and beef meatballs served with savory tomato sauce and oregano, and the classic Horiatiki Salad with fresh tomatoes, cucumbers, bell peppers, onions, olives, and feta cheese showcase our commitment to authenticity. Our ambiance further distinguishes us. The interior is adorned with bougainvillea and features serene white and blue walls, evoking the charm of the Greek islands and creating an inviting atmosphere. Since our establishment in 2024, we've become a beloved destination for both locals and visitors seeking a genuine taste of Greece in San Francisco. Our exceptional service reflects the warmth and hospitality of Greek culture, making every dining experience memorable. If you're looking for a unique culinary journey that combines authentic Greek cuisine with an enchanting atmosphere, Milos Meze is the place to be.

Venue ID 2566; address: 6101 California St, San Francisco, CA, 94121; country=US; is_active=1.

Reservations are available 30 days in advance.  Our bar is held nightly for walk-in diners and is available on a first-come, first-served basis.  If you are running late to a reservation, please let us know as soon as possible, as we may give your table to another party after 15 minutes.  Parties of 2 who take longer than 2 hours to complete their meal or parties of 3 or larger who take longer than 2.5 hours may be relocated to our parklet to accommodate later reservations. Please note all savory food items must be ordered by 9:30pm so if you are running late for a 9pm reservation keep that in mind.

Pearl 6101, a dining room and full bar built inside of a restored turn-of-the-century apothecary, is the latest concept from the restaurateurs behind San Francisco’s Pizzetta 211 and Paladar 511 in New Orleans. The menu is California-meets-Mediterranean, and encompasses handmade pastas, seasonal produce, and seafood. Don't miss the inventive cocktails for pairing. Best of all, it’s primarily female-driven.

We take pride in sourcing our ingredients from local farms and markets to ensure the freshest, most flavorful dishes possible. Our menu features seasonal produce and house-made bread, and we're particularly excited to offer our signature Voilà French Toast Brioche, which is quickly becoming a local favorite. For something a little more unique, try our Alcatraz Escape shrimp omelet, and of course, no brunch is complete without a warm bowl of our classic French Onion soup. Whether you're looking for a leisurely weekend brunch or a quick bite during the workweek, we invite you to join us in our cozy, inviting space and experience the warm hospitality of Sisterita.

Ristorante Firenze By Night features the best Continental Italian Cuisine in San Francisco. We have carefully selected world renowned dishes from classic and novelle recipes for the enjoyment of the most discriminating palate. We proudly assure you that all food contained in our menu is prepared with the freshest domestic and imported ingredients available. All dishes are prepared with the utmost care by our chef and all selections are made to order.

Originally founded in 1893, Schroeder's longstanding history, friendly atmosphere and convenient downtown location has made the Bavarian inspired beer hall a favorite of San Francisco residents and business professionals for the past 120 years. The original structure was destroyed by the 1906 earthquake and fire before being reopened at its current location of 240 Front Street by Henry Schroeder, who was actively involved in downtown San Francisco's reconstruction. Famous among downtown male clientele until opening its doors to females in the 1970s, Schroeder's continues to be known as a destination for drinks and dining in the Financial District.

We must have 24hr notice for reservation cancellations, otherwise the credit card on file will be charged a cancellation fee. The cancellation fee is $10 per person plus tax. We will hold the reservation for 30min, if there is a no show then we will charge the card.

In order for your party to be sat, we do ask that 75% of the party be present at check-in.

To ensure efficiency of service, all items will be rung under one tab. We can split this check a maximum of three ways. A 20% gratuity is applied to groups of 6 or more. City tax and a 6% Small Business Mandate is also applied to all checks.

Please make note that we do not allow any outside food or drinks, including birthday cakes and desserts, or any large decorations.

San Francisco Brewing Co. at their Ghirardelli Square location stands out thanks to their versatile spaces, unique brewery ambience, and prime waterfront-adjacent setting. Located at 3150 Polk St, just steps from the cable car turnaround, the brewery is perched in the lively Fisherman’s Wharf/North Beach area, an ideal locale that combines tourism appeal with local character.

Cuisine and drink offerings reflect the best of Bay Area pub fare, paired with small-batch, house-brewed beers. Think crispy wings, beer cheese, smash burgers, and flatbread pizzas. Signature beers like Alcatraz Amber Ale, Broadway IPA, Fog City Hazy, and Lombard Lager are poured directly from the brite tanks, supporting an interactive tasting experience.

We do not offer valet parking. There are public parking garages located at 655 Beach Street and at Ghirardelli Square on Larkin Street between N. Point and Beach Streets. 

Reservations are available within 60 days of the calendar date.  A credit card is needed to secure all reservations.  Reservations that are cancelled less than 24 hours prior to the reservation will be subject to a $50 per person fee. The upstairs Private Dining Room cancellation policy is 72 hours prior to the reservation. 

We kindly ask that all guests with dining room reservations order a minimum of three courses per person from our dinner menu.

Our corkage policy is One Hundred dollars per 750 ml bottle; the limit per party is two bottles. The corkage for magnums is Two Hundred dollars; the limit per party is one bottle.

A 7% surcharge will be added for San Francisco Employee Mandates.

We are closed on the following holidays, and may adjust our weekly schedule: 
July 4th, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and New Year’s Eve.

Twenty-six years after opening its doors in San Francisco’s iconic Fisherman’s Wharf neighborhood, Restaurant Gary Danko continues to refine its award-winning combination of classic French cooking, thoughtful and inventive use of local ingredients and personable yet impeccable service. “You don’t just open a great restaurant,” says Chef Gary Danko, “it’s a constant work in progress.”

This commitment to excellence and innovation has earned Restaurant Gary Danko a Grand Award from Wine Spectator, its Five Diamond rating from AAA as well as a coveted Relais & Châteaux designation. The restaurant has also earned several James Beard Awards, including Best New Restaurant, Best Service and Best Chef - California. 

In a warm, enveloping space overhung with orchids and vibrant artworks, an evening at Gary Danko is both intimate and theatrical—a loving nod to an old-world dining experience with its heart thoroughly planted in the new: fresh, locally grown and raised foods drawn from the region’s vast seasonal offerings, prepared with precision and flair.

Reserved Seating and the full Dinner Menu are available in all three dining areas; the Trattoria, Enoteca Bar and Garden Patio. Please note which space you are booking as your table will only be reserved in that specific area.

Established in 1977, on the charming Ark Row in downtown Tiburon, Servino has always been a town favorite for both locals and visitors alike. After spending 22 years on the Waterfront, the Servino Family is now back in the original Trattoria where it all began, this time with the addition of an Enoteca & Bar next-door in the historic "Yellow Ark" complete with a garden patio. 

Our menu is inspired by the seasonal bounty of Northern California, with classic and traditional preparations guided by the tenets of regional Italian cooking, with a special emphasis on the clean flavors of Southern Italy. The same ingredients that make it to our dinner menus, also find their way into Cocktail program, highlighting seasonality with an Italian twist. Likewise, the all-Italian Wine Program follows the same lineage, highlighting both Classical and Natural producers that are guided by their surroundings and work in harmony with the land. 

We welcome you into our dining spaces as if you were coming to our house or our homeland to celebrate a special occasion and live like you are part of the family. We look forward to welcoming you back, and continuing the legacy for many years to come. Salute e Boun Appetito!

Created by chef Susan Dunn, Esme reflects a deep commitment to the neighborhood and the kind of place where anyone can become a regular. The team behind it includes some of San Francisco’s most experienced restaurant professionals, brought together by a shared passion for hospitality.

Housed within the historic Metro Hotel, Esme is part of a broader effort to reimagine and revitalize the space. In close collaboration with the family who has long stewarded the building, the restaurant honors its past while contributing to its next chapter.

Please note that we accept reservations until 10:30 PM from Sunday through Thursday, and until 11:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays. After that, we operate on a first-come, first-served basis for walk-ins. All reservations are for a maximum of 2-hour time slots.

For parties of six or more, a credit card is required to secure the reservation. Cancellations must be made at least two hours before the reservation time. Cancellations made within two hours of the reservation, as well as no-shows, will be charged a fee of $20 per guest, plus applicable tax. Any waiver of this fee is at the restaurant’s sole discretion.

To make a reservation for groups of 13 guests or more, please email us at reservations@cavanasf.com. For groups of 20 guests or more, please book through our large group sales department at events@cavanasf.com.

Reservations for the outdoor terraces may be canceled due to unexpected weather conditions. If your reservation is canceled, we will arrange a new booking for your party at the soonest available time upon request. Please send your request to reservations@cavanasf.com.

Cavaña is a Latin American cocktail bar located on the rooftop level of LUMA Hotel San Francisco. Cavaña celebrates the spirit and flavors of Latin America through food & beverage, music, and art. Our shareable food menu features a mosaic of flavors from Central and South America and an extensive cocktail program comprising modern and innovative drinks with an expansive collection of sugarcane and agave distillates.

KAIYŌ Rooftop offers an elevated rooftop bar experience featuring Nikkei-inspired cocktails and shareable cuisine, all set against sweeping views of the San Francisco skyline. Join us for one of the city’s most stunning sunsets as the sky glows over Oracle Park and downtown, creating an unforgettable backdrop for your evening. Whether you’re visiting for golden hour or a vibrant night out, the atmosphere and views, food and beverage experience in such a unique setting is  truly unmatched.

For a more traditional dining experience, we invite you to enjoy dinner in our ground floor restaurant, then head upstairs for pre- or post-dinner cocktails on the rooftop.

We’re located on the 12th floor of the Hyatt Place Hotel in SOMA, next door to Oracle Park, near Chase Center, and just a few blocks from the Moscone Convention Center.

Our rooftop is fully open-air, including the dining area, offering a true outdoor setting. San Francisco weather can shift quickly, so we recommend dressing in layers. To keep you comfortable, KAIYŌ Rooftop is equipped with built-in heaters and wind shields throughout the space. In the event of severe weather such as heavy wind or rain, we reserve the right to cancel reservations for guest safety and comfort. We will always do our best to notify you in advance and assist with rescheduling.

Venue ID 96141; address: 2336 Chestnut St, San Francisco, CA, 94123; country=US; is_active=1.
The nearest parking garage can be found just a couple of blocks away on Pierce St between Lombard and Chestnut.

Causwells SF is proud to introduce Martini Room, a new weekly cocktail experience starting 8/6/26 celebrating one of the world's most iconic drinks. Designed as an extension of the restaurant's bar program, Martini Room transforms the bar into a destination where exceptional martinis, thoughtfully designed food, and warm hospitality come together in a fun, energetic, and comfortable setting. Martini Room represents the next evolution of the Causwells brand by creating a focused experience centered entirely around the martini. The cocktail menu features nine specialty martinis organized into three Martini styles: Dry, Bright & Juicy, and Savory. There is a very concise supporting menu to the cocktails. This menu is what the team considers the perfect drinking food. Please note that this petite menu only will be offered in the Martini Room.

Cancellation Policy 

Due to our limited space and for the sustainability of our small business, we have a strict cancellation policy. Any cancellations, no-shows, or changes to your reservation within 2 days (48 hours; for 1 - 5 people) and 4 days (96 hours; for 6+ people) are subject to a ◉ non-refundable ◉ $150 per guest. Thank you for understanding.

Reservations

Reservations are available within a 21-day period, released at 11 PM each night. In order to provide the best dining experience, we ask everyone to arrive promptly. For arrivals 15+ minutes late guests may have to join the meal at its current course.

Corkage
• $50
• $65 for bottles on our menu
• Limit one bottle per party (up to 750ml)

An intimate 7-seat counter experience (with advance reservations, only). The multi-course omakase menu features fish sourced directly from Tokyo's Toyosu Market as well local, seasonal vegetables.

KEN is the first restaurant and an evolving venture of Chef Ken. He previously developed his passion with Chef Mitsunori Kusakabe over 17 years.
